camel_example: aliyun cloudapi AddTrafficSpecialControl --region cn-hangzhou --SpecialKey 3382463 --TrafficControlId tf123456 --SpecialType APP --TrafficValue 10000
description_en: Adds a custom special policy to a specified throttling policy
description_zh: 在指定流控策略下添加用户自定义特殊流控策略
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi add-traffic-special-control --traffic-control-id tf123456 --special-type APP --special-key 3382463 --traffic-value 10000 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddTrafficSpecialControl

parameters.help_en: The ID of the specified throttling policy
parameters.name: traffic_control_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the special throttling policy. Valid values:

- **APP**

- **USER**
parameters.help_zh:
特殊流控类型，可选值：

- **APP**：应用
- **USER**：用户
parameters.name: special_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app or Alibaba Cloud account. Specify this parameter based on the value of the **SpecialType** parameter. You can view your account ID on the [Account Management](https://account.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.3f053654YpMPwo#/secure) page
parameters.help_zh: 根据**SpecialType**填写对应的AppId或者阿里云账号ID（账号ID请到[账号管理](https://account.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.3f053654YpMPwo#/secure)页面查看）
parameters.name: special_key
